content.title: About
content.content: The non‑citrus carbonated fruit juice drink is a refreshing beverage made from fruit juices without any citrus flavors. It offers a mild sweetness, gentle carbonation, and a bright fruit taste that appeals to a wide range of consumers.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The drink is produced from concentrates of various fruits such as apple, pear, and grape.
Absence of citrus makes it suitable for people with citrus allergies.
Carbonation is achieved by adding food‑grade carbon dioxide, giving the drink its characteristic fizz.
Natural flavorings and a modest amount of sugar or sugar substitutes are often included.
The beverage can be used in cocktails and mixers without risking flavor clashes with citrus ingredients.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: The fruit juices used in the drink contain vitamins B1, B2, and B6, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: With a high water content, the drink helps maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Low acidity
items.content: The lack of citrus results in lower acidity, which may be gentler on sensitive stomachs.

items.title: Antioxidant compounds
items.content: Fruit extracts are rich in polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Digestive support
items.content: Mild carbonation can promote a feeling of lightness after meals.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Some versions may contain significant amounts of sugar, which should be considered by people with diabetes or weight concerns.

items.title: Carbonation
items.content: Consuming large quantities of carbonated drinks can cause bloating or discomfort in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Fruit allergies
items.content: Individuals may be allergic to specific fruits used in the formulation.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Preservatives may be added to extend shelf life, which are not suitable for all consumers.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve chilled as a standalone refreshing drink or as a base for non‑alcoholic cocktails. Adding a slice of fresh fruit can enhance the aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days.
